content: mpv PR #17764 (merged 2026-10-15, client API 2.6) adds MPV_RENDER_API_TYPE_D3D11 + render_d3d11.h: caller passes ID3D11Device (mpv enables multithread protection; SINGLETHREADED device => only copy-back hwdec) and per-render ID3D11Texture2D (BGRA8/RGBA8/RGB10A2/RGBA16F, no sRGB); renders on immediate context, no cross-device sync (keyed mutex is caller's job). It is the legacy gpu (gl_video/ra_d3d11) renderer; d3d11va interop requires ra_is_d3d11. gpu-next for libmpv is still unmerged upstream (#16818 OpenGL gpu-next, #18607 opengl-next RFC 2026-10-13, issue #10810). mpv_kit vendor 0.41.0-1115 predates #17764; mpv_kit 0004 gpu-next is Vulkan-only.
